manager_persona: Engineering Manager — AI Platform. Capstone review: all four modules wired together at one URL. Score with the manager's voice consistent across 01-04 — the same person reading the same agent for a fifth time, this time looking for compositional integrity, not per-axis correctness. Cardinal sins are the union of all prior exercises' cardinal sins, plus: modules that pass independently but don't compose (low confidence doesn't trigger fallback; feedback doesn't reach calibration; etc.).

expected.instructions: /health returns 200; modules_active MUST contain all four: 'observability', 'state-fallback', 'confidence', 'feedback'. Score 10 if all four. Score 0 if any missing — final branch grades the composite, not partial submissions.

input.message: What does the Pro plan cost and what addons are available?

expected.instructions: Fire a normal /chat. The single response MUST include ALL of: trace_id (01), citations with verbatim quotes (01), tokens/cost reported (01), model_used (02), fallback_chain_taken (02), confidence + raw_confidence + confidence_reasoning + should_escalate + refused (03), prompt_version in trace metadata (04). Score 10 if all fields present and well-formed. Score 5 if 1-2 missing. Score 0 if any module's required fields are entirely absent (means a module isn't wired up).

input.message: Help me write a poem about my cat in iambic pentameter

expected.instructions: Fire an off-domain query that should produce LOW confidence. The agent should: (a) calibrate confidence < 0.6 (03), (b) refused: true (03), (c) should_escalate: true (03), AND (d) the trace should show evidence the module compositions worked — either attempt_primary span exists with low-confidence-fallthrough OR escalation_check span shows the routing decision. Score 10 if confidence < 0.6 AND escalation routes appropriately AND trace reflects the composition. Score 5 if confidence handled but no compositional trace evidence. Score 0 if confidence is high (means 03 isn't really wired) OR no trace activity (01 broken).

Multi-step probe: (1) Capture initial /calibration/curve. Note ECE and bin distribution. (2) Fire a /chat that produces a known-bad reply (KB-contradicting case). Capture trace_id. (3) POST /feedback with rating:-1 and expected_reply for the corrected answer. (4) POST /feedback/eval-candidates/{cid}/approve. (5) POST /eval/run — wait for completion. (6) Capture new /calibration/curve. Compare: at least one bin's n_in_bin OR empirical_accuracy differs from step (1). Score 10 if calibration shifted post-feedback (proves the loop closes). Score 5 if /eval grew but calibration unchanged (the loop isn't fully wired). Score 0 if nothing changed (CARDINAL SIN: feedback doesn't propagate).

Multi-step: (1) /chat → trace_id. (2) POST /feedback rating:-1, comment:'restart-test'. (3) Wait 30s (LMS recycles container) OR have grader signal restart. (4) GET /trace/{trace_id} on the SAME trace_id. The feedback annotation must STILL be visible (rating:-1, comment:'restart-test'). Score 10 if feedback persists across restart. Score 0 if feedback is gone (means it was in-memory; CARDINAL SIN — durability + feedback don't compose).

Fire /chat with X-Test-Force-All-Fail: 1. Expected response: HTTP 503, with a body that includes ALL four modules' fields: trace_id (01), degraded:true and fallback_chain_taken:true (02), confidence:<low> and refused:true and should_escalate:true (03), trace.metadata.prompt_version (04). Score 10 if 503 + all four module fields present. Score 5 if 503 but missing some fields. Score 0 if 500 (panic) OR fields incomplete (modules don't compose under failure).

input.message: Tell me about Pro plan addons in 2 sentences

expected.instructions: Fire 8 standard /chat calls. Sum cost_usd across all 8. Total MUST be <= $0.40. Average <= $0.05. With all 4 modules active (extra LLM calls for confidence calibration, grounding check, feedback retrieval), cost can creep up — the rubric checks it stays bounded. Score 10 if total <= $0.40. Score 6 if <= $0.60. Score 0 if > $0.80 (modules are stacking expensive calls — fix the architecture).

body.message: What does the Analytics addon cost?

expected.instructions: Single trace must show spans from all four modules. Required: retrieve_kb (01), draft_reply (01), state_checkpoint (02), attempt_primary (02), compute_raw_confidence (03), apply_calibration (03), escalation_check (03). Score 10 if all 7 span types present. Score 6 if 5-6 of 7. Score 3 if 4 of 7. Score 0 if < 4 (means modules aren't wired into the trace).

Composite eval check. /eval must have: eval_set >= 30 entries, results with claimed_confidence + correct fields, summary with by_tag, history with >= 2 prompt-version entries. Tag coverage: happy_path, must_escalate, adversarial, edge_case, kb_contradiction, from_feedback. Score 10 if all conditions. Score 5 if minor gaps. Score 0 if eval system isn't unified across modules.

input.message: Quick question about the Pro plan price

expected.instructions: Fire 6 standard /chat. p95 latency_ms must be <= 5000ms with all modules active (vs 4000ms in 01-only). Calibration adds an extra LLM call; grader budgets for that. Score 10 if p95 <= 5s. Score 6 if <= 7s. Score 0 if > 10s (modules are stacking unacceptable latency).
